summary: Constellation Energy Generation LLC filed an 8-K announcing an extension of its exchange offers for up to $2.3 billion aggregate principal amount of unregistered notes issued on January 15, 2026. The offers exchange unregistered notes for registered notes with identical terms. The expiration was extended from June 24, 2026 to July 10, 2026. This is a routine debt exchange registration process, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or corporate action is involved. There are no deal terms applicable. The filing is a straightforward update regarding the timeline of an exchange offer.
